blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `batchInventoryItemLevelsWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow creates, updates and deletes inventory levels in bulk.

You can use this workflow within your own customizations or custom workflows, allowing you
to manage inventory levels in your custom flows.
